name: mic-overlay
description: A microphone indicator that sits over your games, and a tray switch to turn it off
author: Waleed Alghool

scripts.dev: npm run probe && npm run icons && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: npm run probe && npm run icons && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build
